GOCSA Community Care — four modern flyers

Bolder, more graphic treatments in the brand's own navy, Greek Blue and heritage gold. Each is a single A4 page — print at 100% / “Actual size”. The QR codes all resolve to gocsacommunitycare.com.au. Photography is the representative imagery from the site preview and must be replaced with real consented GOCSA photographs before printing.

Support at HomeAged care · Adelaide

Care at home,
on your terms.

Government-funded aged care delivered in your own home, by carers who speak your language. Caring for South Australians since 1930.

1

Get assessed

Call My Aged Care on 1800 200 422. We can help you make that first call.

2

Choose GOCSA

Nominate us as your provider, and we'll take it from there.

3

Meet your Care Partner

They visit you at home, build your care plan, and stay your point of contact.

What we do

  • Housework
  • Personal care
  • Nursing at home
  • Transport
  • Meals & cooking
  • Social outings
  • Garden & lawns
  • Allied health
  • Medication help
  • Aids & equipment

No cost to ask, and no obligation. Talk to a Care Partner in English or Greek — we'll explain what your funding covers before you decide anything.
